about: THE BUILD'S GRAPH (kb/Work PB5207, PB5218, PB5231; scripts/buildgraph.py). Each target has a KIND: a `test` target is a test assembly, which records a PASS; a `generated` target is a Python command that writes declared OUTPUTS into a directory of the worktree's own and records their DIGEST. Each declares its INPUTS (path patterns, each naming its reader), its exclusions (each naming why), the FACETS its key covers (all of `facets` unless it names fewer) and the targets it DEPENDS on. A target's key is a digest of its facets, the OUTPUT DIGEST of each dependency (never the dependency's inputs) and the git blob ids of the tracked paths its inputs match, less its exclusions; its record is stored once per target and key in the one store every worktree shares. An input missed here is a FALSE GREEN: the BUILD TARGETS audit (`python scripts/buildgraph.py check`) fails when a test source of an assembly names a repository path outside its target's inputs, and every run of a generated target is traced and refused when it reads outside its inputs. The test targets' order is the gate's host start order, the longest population first; scripts/test_population.py GATED_ASSEMBLIES reads the test assemblies from here (kb/Work PB5230).

preflight.about: THE GATE'S PREFLIGHT (kb/Work PB5872; scripts/gate_legs.py `Legs.preflight`; DESIGN-test-build-ci.md section 3.14.15): the test classes, declared per test target as its `preflight` (class -> why), whose red means a DERIVED OR PINNED FILE IS STALE (a snapshot, a pin, a measured file the code must equal) and which run in seconds. In a code-lane gate they run after the build and before the whole population, one host per assembly; a red one ends the gate RED at once, its verdict line saying PREFLIGHT and naming the case, and the whole population does not run. On a green preflight the population runs as before, less the cases the preflight ran: no case runs twice (the population check reads both trx files, and a case in both is RAN TWICE). The BUILD TARGETS audit (`python scripts/buildgraph.py check`, `preflight_findings`) holds the declaration to the budget below: every declared class is declared in its project's sources and MEASURED in the committed weights file (each class's median merge-group seconds), no class weighs more than `class_weight_s`, and the classes weigh no more than `total_weight_s` together, so a class that takes minutes cannot be declared.
preflight.measurement: Chosen 2026-11-16 from this host's gate records (every worktree's TestResults/build-local/*/verdict.json and the trx beside it: 166 records, 53 full-lane RED, 28 with an audit red, 26 with a test red), ranked by how often a class was a run's ONLY red class and by its own seconds there. Admitted (only-red runs / runs red at all, median local seconds): Characterization whole (EmittedCSharpSnapshotTests 2/2, 6.6 s; DiagnosticSnapshotTests, GateLegDriftTests, RuntimeApiGuardTests and SmokeTests 0/0, 3.7 s together: the 37-case target, which then starts no population host); Unit Architecture.BinderMemberReadersDriftTests 2/5, 2.1 s, RuntimeAbiPinDriftTests 1/2, 0.4 s, DocumentedFactsDriftTests 0/5, 0.1 s; RepoDrift ArchitectureEdgesDriftTests 1/3, 11.1 s, Architecture.BackendContractDriftTests 1/1, 1.1 s; Conformance ArchOracleDriftTests 2/3, 0.8 s. Left out: SpecTraceabilityInventoryDriftTests (1/3, 36.2 s; weight 16.9, over the class budget); ConformanceSuiteTests_P14, SortMergeDifferentialTests and BothRunnersVerdictDriftTests_P3 (a behaviour red, 19 to 570 s); the source-shape drift tests red once beside others (RecordAreaUse, CobolSpace, StageOwnedDirectiveOperand, LiteralAliasResolution, BoundDeferral: no derived file); DialectBehaviorRegistryDriftTests (never red).

differential.about: THE PROGRAM DIFFERENTIAL'S CLASSIFICATION (kb/Work PB4333; scripts/gate_differential.py; DESIGN-test-build-ci.md section 3.14.13). Every input above is classed here by its own pattern, and a narrower pattern may class a part of one (the longest pattern a path lies under wins); buildgraph.load_targets refuses an input with no class, so the BUILD TARGETS audit is the drift test. `program`: its effect on a carried case is that case's emitted program bytes and diagnostics, which the oracle's digests name. `case`: its effect is a file a case names (its manifest entry names its source, data and expected output, each in the case's digest). `everything`: any other effect, so the paths of this class, the facets, the suite manifest's non-case content and `inputs` below make the HARNESS KEY, and a case is carried only from passes recorded at the same harness key. In doubt, `everything`.
